english.notes:
(i) Section 346(2) of the Armed Forces Act 2006 provides that the section applies to anything done in the United Kingdom, the Isle of Man or a British overseas territory.
(ii) See section 347 of the Act if the offence was committed outside the United Kingdom.
(iii) This offence may be committed by non military individuals who may be dealt with by a non military court.
